2022_288_sep_2022_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly purchasing-card (PCARD) transaction listing for September 2022, printed 11/10/2022 and carried on the Board of Education agenda for the November 15, 2022 meeting. The 38-page report itemizes every card charge and credit by transaction description, journal-entry description (SEP PCARD EXP), budget unit, account code, transaction amount, and credit, covering purchase dates from 8/26/2022 through 9/26/2022. The listing closes with a subtotal of 335,507.14 in transaction amounts, 5,440.27 in credits, and Total Expenses of 330,066.87. Single largest charges include 15,293.29 to BEACON ATHLE and 13,798.00 to SP ANYTIMEBA, both in athletics and operations budget units.
